summary: Rebelle Records AB is a record label founded by Björn Afzelius in 1988. Its name combines the names of his two daughters, Rebecca and Isabelle. The company holds the rights to all of Afzelius's music and is now located in Snekkersten, Denmark.
one_line: Rebelle Records AB is a record label founded in 1988 by Björn Afzelius, which holds the rights to his music.
